Good to know

Questions before we begin.

How long does a website take?

Most Starter and Business sites take 4–8 weeks from agreed content to launch. Larger projects are planned in clear stages, with timings confirmed before we start.

Will I own my website?

Yes. Build-only projects are handed over in full once the final balance is paid. Managed monthly sites are transferred at the end of the agreed term if you decide to move on.

Can you help with words and images?

Yes. Every project includes copy structure and practical guidance. Full copywriting and photography can be added when you need more hands-on help.

What happens after launch?

You can take the site and manage it yourself, or keep us close for hosting, updates, improvements and ongoing search support.
